method: concept-anchor semantic scoring plus required subagent/human review

evidence_thresholds.high: 5+ independent manual live captures, 3+ engines, 2+ source domains, no target-seeded evidence
evidence_thresholds.medium: 3+ independent manual live captures, 2+ engines, no target-seeded evidence
evidence_thresholds.low: thin evidence, target-seeded evidence, non-live evidence, or insufficient independence

required_review: semantic support review against exact evidence units
source/citation support review before authority claims
